bullets.text: Under supervision, implemented reusable Python modules for the capstone workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.
Ran supplied NLTK tokenization and frequency-count steps on public news document samples, then inspected frequent terms with guidance using the provided topic-coding guide.

Under supervision, joined document identifiers to publication metadata using pandas merges, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons with Matplotlib, and documented missing-data handling.
As an individual contribution within supervised research, implemented reusable Python workflow modules and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.
Under supervision, applied a documented topic dictionary to public policy document samples and checked dictionary matches against manually reviewed examples.
Under supervision, validated pandas merges with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, then used Matplotlib to visualize how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
